archetypes.name: clarify-flow
archetypes.rationale: Clarify state and publish gates changed across Python and Bash.
archetypes.prompt_body: Review the clarify fetch and publish flow end to end. Check request-id handoff, plan-write fail-closed behavior, response posting, label cleanup, and rename gating against the plan. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.

archetypes.name: bash-contract
archetypes.rationale: The new wrapper sits on launcher, route-state, and quiet-helper boundaries.
archetypes.prompt_body: Focus on Bash integration details in design-clarify.sh. Verify launcher argv handling, session env sourcing, route-state repo fallback, Bash 3.2 portability, and helper stdout parsing are robust. Cite specific file paths and line ranges for any issues found, and follow the output-format rules from your outer wrapper exactly.
